entry_thesis: Burlington Stores exhibiting classic pre-earnings momentum with BURL up ~16% over the past quarter at $300.75, with volume building ahead of Q4 FY2025 earnings due March 5. Consumer Defensive sector showed explosive volume breakouts on March 3, VIX declining to 23.57. Analyst targets raised aggressively — Citi $380, Wells Fargo $400 — representing 25-33% upside from current levels.
risk: Earnings miss or weak forward guidance could trigger a sharp reversal, with stop-loss at $280 (-6.9%).
catalyst: Q4 FY2025 earnings release March 5, with strong consumer sector momentum and analyst upgrades
